mainEntity.name: What factors should a multi-location business consider when choosing an AEO provider?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO provider, a multi-location business should evaluate several key factors. Look for providers with proven experience in multi-location digital marketing and a deep understanding of AI-powered search algorithms and voice assistants. Assess their approach to data management and consistency across numerous locations and platforms. Review their reporting capabilities to ensure transparency in performance metrics specific to each branch. Expertise in local SEO, structured data, reputation management, and content optimization for local intent are crucial. Finally, consider their communication style and ability to integrate with your existing marketing efforts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO provider with multi-location experience, strong data management, transparent reporting, expertise in local SEO and structured data, and effective communication skills.
